items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: So I gave Buck about four or five lessons.

ctx.x: I get $25.00 a lesson. He said, well, some of those lessons are three hours, you ought to get double for those. I said, no, it's just for a lesson. And needless to say, he paid me more than I wanted.

Then about a year later he said, 'would you do the same for Buck Clayton?' I said, well, I'd heard about Buck and I wanted to offer, I sent word to Buck that maybe I could help him. But, I said, it's the same kind of situation, I've known him and he knows me, and it's hard to have any faith in somebody that you've seen around, you know. So finally Jonah said, I bought him 20 whiskeys, I pulled his throat and turned him every way but loose. And finally he dragged him down to my studio, pushed him in and said, sit…
